data.title: Lozenge Composition with Yellow, Black, Blue, Red, and Gray

thumbnail.alt_text: A square white tile, rotated 90 degrees, crossed by black lines intersecting at 90-degree angles. A few of the shapes thus formed—some partial squares, some rectangles—are colored in a single shade of yellow, blue, black, or red.
